partners.mechanism_chain: SERPINF2 (HGNC:10594) —DISRUPTS→ fibrinolysis (GO:0006579); SERPINF2 (HGNC:10594) —LEADS_TO→ alpha-2-plasmin inhibitor deficiency (MONDO:0009883); SERPINE1 (HGNC:10593) —DISRUPTS→ fibrinolysis (GO:0006579); SERPINE1 (HGNC:10593) —LEADS_TO→ congenital plasminogen activator inhibitor type 1 deficiency (MONDO:0013227); fibrinolysis (GO:0006579) —DECREASES→ fibrin (CHEBI:57753). partners.mechanism_chain: SERPINF2 (HGNC:10597) —DISRUPTS→ fibrinolysis (GO:0006567); SERPINF2 (HGNC:10597) —BINDS→ plasmin (UniProtKB:P00749); plasmin (UniProtKB:P00749) —DISRUPTS→ fibrinolysis (GO:0006567); fibrinolysis (GO:0006567) —LEADS_TO→ alpha-2-plasmin inhibitor deficiency (MONDO:0009883); HRG (HGNC:4908) —DISRUPTS→ thrombin generation (GO:0007596); HRG (HGNC:4908) —BINDS→ fibrin clot (GO:0007596); thrombin generation (GO:0007596) —LEADS_TO→ fibrin clot (GO:0007596); fibrin clot (GO:0007596) —LEADS_TO→ hereditary thrombophilia due to congenital histidine-rich (poly-L) glycoprotein deficiency (MONDO:0013143); fibrinolysis (GO:0006567) —DECREASES→ thrombin generation (GO:0007596).
